cues: Words of time and place move away from the speaker's moment.
Now becomes then; today, that day; tonight, that night; yesterday, the previous day; tomorrow, the next day; last week, the previous week; ago, before; here, there; this and these, that and those.
I met him here yesterday, she said, becomes: she said that she had met him there the previous day.
